bindings.label: One-day-old male infant has not passed stool since birth and has increased bilious vomiting and abdominal swelling
Born at term, birth weight 3.1 kg, no significant prenatal history, uncomplicated delivery

Catheter could not be inserted more than half an inch into the anal opening
